notes.title: Lost in Fantaland 1.0 Released Now!
notes.content:
Hello, dear players!

We are thrilled to announce that after two years of continuous development and optimization, Lost in Fantaland has finally transitioned from its Early Access (EA) version to the 1.0 release today!

During the EA period, we completed the development of six characters across three classes, nearly reworked the Brave character entirely, and enhanced the differentiation among characters to provide a more distinctive experience for players. 

We also added ten levels of difficulty, including mutated enemies and adverse weather conditions for you to challenge. Additionally, we've introduced numerous traps, bosses, monsters, treasures, and items, while optimizing many gameplay issues and fixing a plethora of bugs and crashes.

We sincerely thank all of our players for their tremendous support and patience during the EA period. The release of the official version today would not have been possible without your help and dedication!

[h1]Version 1.0 Update Details:[/h1]
[h3]New Content:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Full controller support, including popular PC controllers, Xbox series controllers, DualShock 4, DualSense, and Steam Deck.
[*] New feature: Cards that have been carried and completed a run now have a background texture for distinction.
[*] New Chapter 1 Boss: Wandering Witch.
[*] New treasures: Maneki-neko (招财猫), Firework Kit, Frying Pan, Frying Pan EX, Fire Fan EX.
[*] New items: Tweezer, Pudding, Tomato, Bitter Melon, Laxative, Throwing Hammer, Concealed Weapon V2.0, Pink Gummy, Molotov Cocktail, Potato, Holy Potion.
[*] New battlefield interaction: Displacement Orb.
[/list]
[h3]Content Changes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Improved tutorial level experience.
[*] When resetting a battle, players will be prompted if they wish to continue after a character's death.
[*] Various UI optimizations and added sound effects.
[/list]
[h3]Content Fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] A large number of bug fixes and translation corrections.
[/list]

[h1]Future Plans:[/h1]
Regarding the future of Lost in Fantaland after version 1.0, it largely depends on the success of the release, as our current revenue hasn't yet covered the previous development costs. However, there are several things we are confident about:
[list]
[*] We are eagerly working on porting the game to mobile and console platforms.
[*] We will continue fixing bugs, balancing adjustments, and improving user experience.
[*] If we secure sufficient financial support, we hope to develop new content for the game, such as new modes and DLCs in the future.
[*] Over the past few years, we've accumulated many new game ideas, and we hope to quickly prototype some new games and share them with you.
[/list]

[h1]Special Thanks:[/h1]
Below is a list of friends who have provided significant help and support for our game. Although there's a thank-you list within the game, we are still immensely grateful.
[list]
[*] Arkuktor (Discord)
[*] Paradoxica (Discord)
[*] 咪优 (QQ)
[*] Zhang Jing (ジン)
[*] 无月白熊
[/list]

Thank you all for your understanding, support, and patience throughout these years!
Thank you!
By Supernature Studio

notes.title: REGULAR UPDATE 20240124
notes.content:
Hello everyone, we have a game update! (Still surviving...)

[h2]Changes：[/h2]
[list]
[*] We have undertaken a massive amount of translation and proofreading work (English, Japanese, Traditional Chinese). This task alone has consumed a considerable amount of time as we needed to handle numerous localized content issues, such as mistranslations, errors, and typos.
[*] There have been extensive UI adjustments and optimizations, with larger and clearer text. To ensure that players of different languages can easily read, we have put in a lot of effort to optimize almost half of the UI panels.
[*] The movement speed of characters on the battlefield has been increased.
[*] The option to purchase the 2x game speed has been removed and now it is available by default.
[*] On the world map, the icon of Artifact Fragments will be marked when there are upgradeable items available.
[*] Effects triggered by Recycle Box (and other Artifacts) will occur after drawing cards instead of entering the battlefield.
[*] If a boss enemy enters an unattackable state while having throwing knives embedded, they will throw the knives to the ground.
[*] The "Reset Move" button can now be used even when a card is selected.
[*] The cold effects have been simplified.
[*] Many missing sound effects have been added.
[*] There are some other changes that we forgot to record...
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fix：[/h2]
[list]
[*] Some lists do not scroll to the top when opened for the second time.
[*] Can not pause in the world map/battlefield by pressing ESC.
[*] Pressing Enter does not execute confirmation-type actions.
[*] After pausing during a battle using shortcuts, some panels keep opening and unable to play the next battle.
[*] Fixed the scroll image of the world map.
[*] Nodes that have already been visited on the world map still display as "Unknown".
[*] Destroying of shurb happens before damage reduction.
[*] The Trickster can perform diagonal steps while Ensnared.
[*] The black bars indicating selected cards and accumulating armor value do not appear for cards like Flame Shield.
[*] The visual effect of the electric mark has issues when the enemy flips horizontally.
[*] The effect of Burn occurs after armor is reduced to zero, resulting in armor penetration.
[*] The Natural Force card refreshes the compass when breaking cacti/rock formations.
[*] The conductive spread on the water not occured by lightning weather.
[*] The upgraded version of the Flame Spirit card is missing two keywords.
[*] The sound effect for the Sparkling Grenade explosion is incorrect.
[*] The damage of Instantly Trigger by Void Crystals is doubled.
[*] Void Crystals explode multiple times when met flames on black sand.
[*] Fixed a amount of bugs caused by Tremorg.
[/list]

[h2]About our next update:[/h2]
We have scheduled the next update to be part of the 1.0 version release, which is estimated to be launched around June. The update will include important promised features such as controller support.
At that time, we will conclude the Early Access phase, and we will also simultaneously release versions for the Nintendo Switch and PlayStation platforms.

notes.content:
It was a fundamental update, with the [b]Trickster [/b] added.

[h2]New：[/h2]

[*]New class: Trickster, and new character: Fengshui Master.
[b]Trickster[/b] Fights with tricky spells and utilizes the environment. Suits skilled players better.

[h2]Content change：[/h2]
[olist]
[*]Fire Mage's Gas Jet is now a golden card.
[*]"Skeleton Altar" and "Roulette Altar" no longer cost AP or Mana.
[*]Effect of Artifact "Feather Dart" is changed to double damage.
[*]Adjusted the order of items in the Soul Orbs Shop.
[*]Added an new Artifacts 'Steel Lock'.
[*]Increased the damage of Card“Courage Burst" by 2.

[/olist]

[h2]Bug Fix：[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed redundant unknown things in the Handbook.
[*]Fixed some other bugs.

[/list]
======================================================================

Sorry for the update arriving late.
This time we spent much time developing the new class and new character. Many initial designs no longer fit into the current game, so we had to redesign them, and there were many issues during the development.
We still aim to bring you a new experience with the new contents, and we hope the new character is fun to play as and easy to pick up.
The new character still has much to adjust, and we'll keep the optimizations coming.

On the other hand, we've temporarily removed the Vagrant subclass of the Warrior class. We initially planned to make Vagrant a demanding character that integrates features of other Warrior classes, but since the ascension mode became available, other classes have become more challenging, so Vagrant no longer serves its original purpose.
Therefore, we believe we should save our energy and resources for optimizations of the game's core contents.
We appreciate all players' support and passion for our game. Although we always strive to provide the best gaming experience, sometimes we have to make hard decisions to ensure the game's sustainability.

We promise to keep bringing as many exciting contents and features to the game as we can.
If you have any question or feedback, please don't hesitate to contact us. Your opinions are highly valued.
Thank you again for your understanding and lasting support.
Yours sincerely,

Supernature Studio

notes.title: DEV LOG #1
notes.content:
[h1]A Summary of Lost in Fantaland’s Early Access Version Updates Between Sep 27–Sep 30[/h1]

Dear players, we've received your feedback!
Since the launch last week, we've been on pins and needles, worried that our game may fail to meet your expectations.
In the first week, we've been handling crashes and bugs.
The major issues in gaming experience reported so far include: Warrior cards lack the depth for forming styles; some cards are hard to understand; some cards' costs are not reasonable, etc. We'll optimize the game accordingly. On the other hand, due to cultural and background differences, the story isn't well-received in some countries and regions. We may need more help to solve this problem. If you are willing to help, please contact us at supernature.game@qq.com
Starting from the next week, we'll be spending more time on adjusting cards, handling user experience issues, and adding more content.

[h2]Bug Fix:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Gentleman's Hand won't turn into multiple copies now. (Maybe...)
[*] Special cards won't appear in handbook before used.
[*] Fixed the wrong price of Roasted Meat.
[*] Fixed an error in Artifact refreshment.
[*] Fixed the basic crash protection when the system language is a foreign language.
[*] Fixed an error in which you can't press Esc to quit the game when an error message appears.
[*] Peripheral device testing errors no longer count as game errors, otherwise the game will crash upon starting.
[*] No more crashes when both the draw pile and discarded pile are empty.
[*] No more crashes when a Frost Worm jumps out of a Frostworm Nest and falls right onto a Bush grid with snow.
[*] No more crashes when you click an item too frequently.
[*] No more crashes when a profile isn't successfully loaded or saved (but the data won't be saved in that case).
[*] Added code protection to various other crashes.
[*] The prompt text "Cripple" will appear when you use Reckless Strike.
[*] The prompt text "Fury" will appear when you right-click Wolves and Werewolves.
[*] Fixed the wrong prices of Roasted Drumstick and Roasted Meat.
[*] Fixed some wrong traditional Chinese characters.
[*] Fixed some crashes in special scenarios.
[*] Fixed some bad translations.
[*] Fixed the Chinese descriptions of Sword, Hero's Sword, and Yokai Blade.
[*] There will be no more Legacy locations after clearing the levels.
[*] Fixed the wrong high-lighted grid when canceling an Oblivion Potion. You no longer have to select precisely 2 cards to use a Strong Oblivion Potion.
[*] Descriptions have been added to trap items.
[*] Fixed various crashes.
[*] Fix Crashes.
[*] The battle victory reward panel: Opening the backpack and eating apple did not regenerate HP; the HP value is incorrectly.
[/list]

[h2]Content changes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] ATK +1 when Harsh Training is upgraded.
[*] Increased Kick & Backflip's basic ATK to 9.
[*] Only Warrior characters can use Restless cards for now. There are 2 in total.
[*] State of Mind's basic DEF +2.
[*] Temporarily removed Simplification, Illusive Shield, and Power of No Action. They will be replaced by less confusing new cards to improve gaming experience.
[*] A lot of English translation updates about basic things, Artifacts, items.
[*] Weakened Weakness Strike's effect by 10%.
[*] Fire Spirit's damage now increases by 2 per turn.
[*] Added a confirmation when leaving the Card Boost House without using the upgrade.
[*] Add 20 initial gold coins for warrior characters
[*] Deletion at the bonfire starts at 8% of max health; increases by 2% after each deletion
[*] Remove some unnecessary dialogue
[/list]

[h2]New feature:[/h2]
[list]
[*] An Abandon button was added to Crash panel.
[*] A new difficulty option：Less Bonfire
[*] Hot key Q and E to rotate map
[*] The Impact between the one with Burn debuff and another one that without Burn will cause another one gain 1 stack of Burn
[/list]

notes.title: Fantaland Adventure Manual: Update Plan & Notes
notes.content:
Hello, brave heroes who have set foot on Fantaland!

Welcome to this fantasy world of cards and wargame! Thank you for playing our game. Before you start your first game, please take a moment to read a few tips from the two elite monsters in sync with each other to help you on your adventure. We've prepared a thorough FAQ and game development planning Q&A, along with some cute little things (see the end of article).

Writing code is really tiring, *yawn* ( - . - )(~O~)......

[h2]I. FAQ[/h2]

[olist]
[*][b]What is the current release form of the game? Do I need to purchase it again after the official release?[/b]
The game is currently available in early access. Players who have purchased the early access version of the game can enjoy future updates before the game officially releases for free, and there is no need to purchase the game again after it's officially released.

[*][b]Why early access?[/b]
Lost in Fantaland has been under development for more than two and a half years. The game is quite playable in its current state. As a two-person indie studio, we decided to launch the early access version to receive player feedback and make preparation for future gameplay design, as well as to alleviate our funding problem.

[*][b]How much content is included in the early access version? How long is the play time?[/b]
The current early access version contains 2 characters (including 1 class branch), a tutorial level and three main story chapters. Players can experience the core gameplay and good replayability in the current version.

[*][b]Which languages does the game support?[/b]
Currently, the game supports Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, English and Japanese. We are sorry for not adding more languages. We will try to add more language support before the early access ends.
[b]Due to a staff shortage in our studio, the game localization is not ideal. You may find some small translation issues or inappropriate expressions in the game. Sorry for the inconvenience. Currently, we're working on a new version of the localization. It'll be added to the game soon.[/b]

[*][b]Does the game support controllers?[/b]
The game doesn't support controllers for now. But we have plans to add controller support. We want to make controllers feel more intuitive instead of just mapping controls to controller buttons.

[*][b]Does the game have an achievement system?[/b]
We've added some achievements. More achievements will be added along with new content.

[*][b]Does the game support multiplayer co-op?[/b]
This is a single-player game. We are not planning to add any multiplayer mechanics. However, we plan to add leaderboards in the future.

[*][b]How long will this game be in early access?[/b]
We plan to release the official version in 2023.

[*][b]Why are characters like Berserker in the demo version locked in the EA version?[/b]
We added Berserker in the demo version to provide players with a unique, different class experience. We have decided to redo characters like the Berserker to make them even more unique.

[*][b]Can I choose the resolution of the game?[/b]
Currently, the game will set the resolution based on the player's monitor resolution. Players cannot manually select the resolution for now.
[/olist]

[h2]II. Development Planning Q&A[/h2]

After the release of the early access version, we will fill and update the content as planned, and share with players actively and regularly what will be updated in the next stage. However, the development plan may change depending on the situation. In order to avoid letting everyone down and to keep our update promises, we will gradually disclose our update plan. Hope you will stay tuned and continue to support us. If you have suggestions or bug feedback, feel free to join our QQ group or leave a message in Discord.

Discord channel: https://discord.com/invite/KPBPftgB92

The next part is our update plan:

[olist]
[*][b]Balance adjustment:[/b]
We will continue to adjust the balance based on your feedback in the long term, and there may be a lot of content deletion, addition or changes.

[*][b]Character and classes:[/b]
The complete game will contain at least 4 Warrior characters, 2 Mage characters and 1-2 Trickster characters.

Class details:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40509393/57bd17ec5b6c6a7ab4e858cc409a03ec659700f0.png[/img]
[table]
    [tr]
        [th]Class[/th]
        [th]Description[/th]
        [th]Current Progress[/th]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]Brave[/td]
        [td]Balanced offense and defense. Good at using a variety of moves to keep his distance from the enemy and taking advantage of the extra effect created by card combos.[/td]
        [td]Almost completed[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td width="100px"]Star Shield Warrior[/td]
        [td]Defensive warrior. He can use starlight flexibly to defend himself against the enemies and perform powerful counterattacks.[/td]
        [td]Development in progress[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]Berserker[/td]
        [td]An extremely aggressive warrior with good offensive capabilities. The player needs to control his HP and use Fury to deal damage to the enemies.[/td]
        [td]Development in progress[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]Vagrant[/td]
        [td]A master warrior who is more flexible but is also more difficult to play as.[/td]
        [td]Development in progress[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]Fire Mage[/td]
        [td]Uses a variety of fire spells and explosions to burn the enemies to death.[/td]
        [td]Almost completed[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]Electric Mage[/td]
        [td]A master of electric spells and uses electric residues to create energy cycles.[/td]
        [td]Development in progress[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]Trickster[/td]
        [td]Trickster knows how to take advantage of the surroundings and traps.[/td]
        [td]Development in progress[/td]
    [/tr]
[/table]

[*][b]Chapters and enemies[/b]
1）In addition to the current tutorial level and the three chapters, we plan to add a [b]Hidden Chapter[/b];
2）We will add more elite monsters, bosses and some mutated monsters, or some monsters with rewards.
3）We will add a variety of Artifacts, items, and possibly new Soul Orb unlockable content and difficulties.
4）Add more combat variations in each chapter to make the process feel less repetitive.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40509393/54f5d4fe40c26bad500f004207b01a73f1d8f447.png[/img]

[*][b]About the gameplay[/b]
1）We plan to finish the basic features such as monster handbook, achievement system, global statistics, game terminology, etc.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40509393/e4036a4ca748af3fe25111c00b8ccc540af05160.png[/img]
2）We are planning a quest system and ultimate ability system.
3）Controller support

[b]We've planned more content and will release them in the future.[/b]
[/olist]

It's not easy to develop indie games. "Lost in Fantaland" is our first game. It requires multiple attempts and endless effort to combine the pixel art style with wargame strategy and deck-building gameplay. During this process, we experienced a lot of difficulties and setbacks. Fortunately, being the "elite monsters," we overcame the problems with only two people and released the game.

We would like to thank all those who helped and supported us during the demo phase. We really appreciate their support for the development of independent games. I hope our game will not disappoint you!

Go, brave heroes! Write your own legend of Fantaland!
